title: docs(plugin-dashboard): shrink UNGATED_DOCS by one — the dashboard README's 12 blocks now compile
body:
Part of #5174 — batch 10 of the `UNGATED_DOCS` shrink. Draft on purpose; not enqueued, auto-merge not enabled.

`packages/plugin-dashboard/README.md` leaves the ledger. Every one of its **12** ts/tsx blocks now compiles against the built `dist/` — no `FRAGMENT_MARKER` was needed, and no entry was added. The ledger hunk is a removal only: `git diff --numstat origin/main...HEAD` on the gate reads `0 2` — zero additions, two deletions.

## What was wrong, and what each block became

The ledger reason measured 19 parse diagnostics and 4 undefined-name diagnostics. Re-measured at the branch point with the gate's own exported `analyze` / `compileSnippets`, that is exactly 3 blocks that never reached the semantic phase plus 1 that did and failed; the other 8 already compiled.

| Block | Was | Now |
|---|---|---|
| Schema API / Dashboard | bare object literal with type annotations (`widgets: Widget[]`) — 5 parse diagnostics | an annotated `DashboardComponentSchema` value |
| Schema API / Metric Card | same shape — 7 parse diagnostics | a `MetricCardNode` value, its keys read off the SHIPPED component via `ComponentProps<typeof MetricCard>` |
| Widget accent colour | bare widget literal — 7 parse diagnostics | an annotated `DashboardWidgetSchema` value |
| DashboardGridLayout | `DashboardGridLayout`, `dashboard`, `client` all ambient — TS2304 x3, TS7006 x1 | a component, with the host-provided names `declare const`-ed against the real types |

The fourth follows the pattern `packages/data-objectstack/README.md` and `packages/plugin-view/README.md` already use for host-provided names. `client` is no longer ambient: it is `adapter.getClient()` on the `ObjectStackAdapter` the sibling README declares, so `client.meta.saveItem` is the real signature and the `if (!next.name) return;` guard the prose spends a paragraph justifying is now enforced by the compiler (probe 2).

The second is the one worth a reviewer's eye. This package ships components, not schema types, and `MetricCardProps` is deliberately NOT on its export surface — the README says so itself. Rather than restate the prop list (a copy that drifts) or mint an export to satisfy a gate, the block reaches the shipped props through `ComponentProps<typeof MetricCard>`. A renamed or retyped prop stops the block compiling (probes 3 and 6).

## Evidence

**The gate, before and after**, its own verdict lines, exit code captured by redirect before any pipe:

```
BEFORE  0246d116e   Scanned 227 document(s): 199 covered (97 of them hold a ts/tsx block), 28 ungated
                    Covered blocks: 589 - 432 to compile, 157 declared fragment(s).
                    Semantic phase: 432 of 432 block(s) judged, 0 failed.

AFTER   e00aa2e17   Scanned 227 document(s): 200 covered (98 of them hold a ts/tsx block), 27 ungated
                    Covered blocks: 601 - 444 to compile, 157 declared fragment(s).
                    Syntax phase:   every block parsed, so every one of them reached the semantic phase.
                    Semantic phase: 444 of 444 block(s) judged, 0 failed.
                    Every covered documentation snippet compiles against the built types.
```

Twelve blocks moved into the compiled population and the declared-fragment count did not move: `157 -> 157`.

**The ledger shrank and did not grow — asserted mechanically, not by eye.** `origin/main`'s copy of the gate was imported alongside this branch's and both were evaluated over the SAME working tree, so the covered-set delta is attributable to the ledger alone:

```
LEDGER entry count: 28 -> 27
ADDED entries: []
REMOVED entries: [packages/plugin-dashboard/README.md]
surviving entries whose REASON TEXT changed: []
COVERED documents: 199 -> 200   STRICTLY GROWS: true
previously-covered docs now UNGATED: []
blocks to compile: 432 -> 444    declared fragments: 157 -> 157    covered blocks: 589 -> 601
build filters ADDED [], REMOVED []
```

**Gate strictness is byte-identical.** Everything from the `Fence scanning` banner to EOF: 794 lines, sha256 `d203debfa0073ccdb527a08e1e191b2d04b4cc00c5303ee27d4bfc76d09c7241` on `origin/main` AND on this branch.

**Six reverse-verification probes**, direction predicted in writing before each run, all six matched, and each was run twice — once at `7845f375e` and again at the merged head `e00aa2e17` with identical results. No build artifact sits between the mutation and the thing under test (the mutation is markdown the gate reads straight from disk; the `dist/` it compiles against is untouched), so no rebuild was needed on either leg. Every leg proved the mutation reached disk (injected text counted, removed text counted to 0, and `git hash-object` shown to DIFFER from the `HEAD` blob), and every restore was proved by `git diff HEAD` empty plus `git hash-object` equal to the `HEAD` blob `ca47432f859d095ba8c8a2f9e9e03b79489cae3a` — never inferred from a trap's exit code.

| Probe | Mutation | Predicted | Observed |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | `colorVariant: 'dangerr'` | RED | exit 1 — `TS2820 ... Did you mean '"danger"'?`, naming all eight tokens |
| 2 | drop `if (!next.name) return;` | RED | exit 1 — `TS2345: Argument of type 'string \| undefined' is not assignable to parameter of type 'string'` |
| 3 | `trend: 'sideways'` | RED | exit 1 — `TS2322 ... not assignable to type '"up" \| "down" \| "neutral" \| undefined'` |
| 4 | `columns` key renamed `columnss` | **GREEN** | exit 0 — `DashboardComponentSchema extends BaseSchema`, which declares `[key: string]: any`, so a wrong TOP-LEVEL KEY raises nothing |
| 5 | `columns: '3'` | RED | exit 1 — `TS2322: Type 'string' is not assignable to type 'number'` |
| 6 | `trendValue` renamed `trendValu` | RED | exit 1 — `TS2561 ... does not exist in type 'MetricCardNode'` |

Probe 4 is the honest half of the green and is measured rather than assumed; probes 5 and 6 bound it from both sides. Where checking starts is exact: on a type that inherits `BaseSchema`'s index signature, the VALUE TYPES of declared members are checked but unknown keys are not; on `MetricCardNode` and `DashboardWidgetSchema`, which carry no index signature, the wrong key IS caught.

## The limit a reader of this green needs

Four of the twelve blocks — Basic Dashboard, Dashboard with Charts, Responsive Dashboard, Customization — are untyped `const schema = { ... }` literals. They were left exactly as they are. They now pass syntax and undefined-name checking, and nothing more: annotating them is what makes them red, because they write component-shaped nodes (`{ type: 'metric-card', value, trend, ... }`, `{ type: 'card', body }`) directly into `widgets[]`, which `DashboardWidgetSchema` rejects with `TS2561` on `value` and `TS2322` on `'card'`. That is a real question about which side is wrong, it already has a card in the backlog, and the measurement was recorded there (objectui#7035) rather than settled here — settling it is not a ledger batch's call, and papering over it by weakening the examples is exactly what this lane forbids.

## Sibling gates, all green at `e00aa2e17`

`check:doc-fences` (227 documents), `check:doc-types` ("Every documented component type is registered."), `check-doc-links` ("Links are valid across 17 scan roots."), `check:control-bytes` (6149 tracked text files) plus a manual `grep -naP` over the C0 set on both changed files with no hits, `check:skill-examples`, and `check:readme-exports` — the last one now judges 408 self-imports, 408 real, 0 fabricated, up from 406 because this diff adds two (`MetricCard` and `DashboardGridLayout`, both real exports).

`check-readme-exports` first exited 1 with 3 findings, all `its type entry ./dist/index.d.ts is not on disk`, none naming a file in this diff. That is a missing precondition, not a verdict: the doc gate's own `--build-filter` is scoped by design to the packages covered documents import, which leaves `plugin-ai` and `plugin-tree` unbuilt. Building them made it a real measurement. It is not reported as a failure of this diff.

**Changeset: none owed, checked at the gate rather than assumed** — precisely because a `packages/*/README.md` ships inside the package's `files`. `node scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs` exit 0: "2 file(s) changed, 0 of them published source of a package the release covers ... so no changeset is owed."

**Tests**, from the repo root (never `pnpm --filter ... exec vitest`), `--maxWorkers=2`, exit 0: `Test Files 22 passed (22)` / `Tests 1163 passed (1163)`. The suite union was re-derived at the merged head by `git grep -l` for the gate's name, the edited document, and the sibling README/fence/type gates — it includes `scripts/__tests__/check-doc-snippet-types.test.ts`, the edited script's own suite. **Lint**: `pnpm run lint:root` exit 0, `32 problems (0 errors, 32 warnings)`, all pre-existing. Not a narrowing: the population read from eslint's own `--format json` is 237 files, of which 0 are `.md`/`.mdx`; the one changed file inside it reports `errorCount 0 warningCount 0`; and `eslint.config.js` sets no `project` / `projectService` / `tsconfigRootDir`, so type-aware linting is off and this diff cannot move the verdict on a file it does not touch.

## Lane discipline

`origin/main` was merged (never rebased) at `a4514e840` — clean, no conflict. It moved `packages/types/src/complex.ts`, so the whole build closure was rebuilt and every number above, the six probes included, was re-taken after that merge at the final commit `e00aa2e17`. Batch 11 is running concurrently on `packages/app-shell/README.md` and edits the same object literal; the condition that lets the two coexist is honoured here — removals only, no entry added, the ledger docblock prose untouched, and `packages/plugin-gantt/README.md` / `packages/plugin-kanban/README.md` (owned by #7302 / `PARTIAL_EXCERPTS`) untouched.
